description: Ask about your profit, cash, sales, and ad spend in plain English. MosoFin reads your connected QuickBooks, Xero, Stripe, Square, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, and Google Ads data, read-only, and explains what changed and why.

defaultPrompt: How did my business do last month, and why?
How much cash do I have, and who owes me?
Where is my money going, and what looks unusual?
interface.longDescription:
MosoFin connects to the tools you already run your business on, so you can ask questions in plain English and get one answer across all of them: accounting (QuickBooks, Xero), payments (Stripe, Square), online stores (WooCommerce, BigCommerce), and advertising (Google Ads).

Ask things like: How did we do last month? How much cash do we have? Who owes us money? Why was this payout lower? Which sales channel earns the most? Is our ad spend paying off? Every answer shows the numbers behind it, so you can check it yourself. MosoFin is read-only and never changes your data.

Accountants and bookkeepers can keep each client in its own workspace and save repeat reviews, like a month-end check, to run again with one ask.
